correctness.rationale: Three conditional payoffs follow hypergeometric sampling without replacement; four-player Fermi+flip transitions define a positive irreducible birth–death chain. Exact detailed-balance stationary weights differentiated at neutrality yield 2mu(1-mu)(r2-5)/[3(3+13mu)(1+15mu)]. Reflection when r2=5 forces half abundance at all delta; two strong-selection rational fractions are checked by a standalone recurrence. Analytic zero-mutation fixation ratio exp(delta sum Delta)=1 establishes limiting 1/2 without claiming a unique zero-mutation invariant law. The self-contained package code passes 72 exact-rational derivative tests plus strong-selection witnesses. Finite tests supplement rather than replace algebraic proof.

value.rationale: At fixed full-cooperation return 9, rare mutation yields exactly neutral selection, whereas any fixed interior mutation rate discriminates two biologically motivated nondecreasing return profiles (1,1,9) and (1,8,9) with opposite cooperation abundances. A sharp intermediate-return threshold and exact finite-strength values quantify a modeling boundary rather than a routine alternative notation. The calculation prevents extrapolating a true rare-mutation endpoint criterion into a positive-mutation setting.
